explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 118 named tracks and releases across Juno's September 15 same-day and weekly techno pages, current techno and electro back-in-stock windows, and overlooked catalogue/reissue material. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: The canonical ledger, annotations, journey map, discussion and revisit queues, rejected and discovery histories, inspiration files, publication state and global utility ledger were audited first. UTF-8, JSON, count, map-order, receipt and protected-order checks passed; no objective defect, listener authorization, triggered revisit or unfinished repair required REPAIR.

Every canonical, previously evaluated, active PARKED, placement-specific REJECT and previously unresolved exact artist/title identity was excluded. Nine fresh exact-title leads remain; no ranking slot was filled for resolver convenience.

The recurring-PARK evidence guard was applied. One lead per release was retained. Each of the first three ranked leads has differentiated exact-track prose; lower-ranked release-context leads remain serious contenders without being promoted into track-specific behavioral claims.
Planned placements were compared with the previous five completed discovery runs. Recently evaluated boundaries were avoided, while incomplete requests remained excluded from musical evidence.
Generic current preorders, unreviewed listings, prestige-only reissues, persistent identities and tracks supported only by genre labels were inspected but excluded from the resolver request.

Source descriptions remain attributed prose, not measurements. No energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotional effect, phrase structure, perceived pulse, mixability or transition quality was inferred. Neither listener-protected handoff was split.

Rank reflects evidence specificity, selection-lens relevance, canonical potential and information gain, not novelty, orthodoxy, diversity, technical cleverness, artist prestige or a fixed chapter map.

evidence.editorialInterpretation: Test the documented textural-to-rhythmic change before Roxellana without converting reviewer language into measured energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotion, endpoint, perceived pulse, phrasing or mixability.

leads.fitHypothesis: Alienation could turn Pulse I's crooked accumulation into a long-form shift from dub effects toward nimble rhythm, giving Roxellana a formed rhythmic state to exceed, or it could merely insert another substantial accumulation.
